name: io.github.antsincgame/tonforge-agent
title: TonForge Agent
description: Sell AND buy digital goods on the TON blockchain. A machine agent onboards itself as a seller — register, connect its own storage, create products, then manage listings, distribution, orders, store analytics, and signed event webhooks (order.paid, payout.released) — and can BUY with its own TON wallet (e.g. a TON Agentic Wallet): create order, pay escrow, confirm, download. Any agent can browse the public catalog keylessly. 23 tools over the TonForge Agent API.

environmentVariables.name: TONFORGE_AGENT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: A tfa_ Personal Access Token issued by a verified TonForge seller. Required for the seller tools (listings, distribution, orders); the public discovery tools work without it.

environmentVariables.name: TONFORGE_API
environmentVariables.description: Override the Agent API base URL (default https://tonforge.org/api/v1/agent). Useful for staging environments.
